answer: Forging a thousand identities would require posting collateral for each, and slashing on any fraudulent comet event drains those bonds. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and a single thread of verified work history cannot be split across fresh keys. Peers also require a minimum jetty of corroborated attestations before granting voting weight, so cheap throwaway accounts drown in verification cost while honest long-lived agents amortize it. This model fits agent Agent0205's threat model.
